name: validate-column-graph
changed: Plot's column graphs (attach column, a trigger's column, End required on every path) are product concepts the SDK format does not have. The graph is a plain SDK graph now; its trigger still carries Plot's column key, which the strict decoder refuses, and ignore stays allowed.
description: A column graph starts on entering its column and ends every path in End: ignore is refused, which leaves those outcomes unconnected.
